snippet.title: Lucy Dreaming - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010040


Lucy Dreaming, the critically-acclaimed, British point & click comedy is coming to PS5 and PS4!

A love-letter to the 90s LucasArts classics, and featuring the voice of Dominic Armato (Monkey Island's Guybrush Threepwood), Lucy Dreaming follows the story of Lucy, a young girl with a recurring nightmare. Can you unlock the secrets to dream control and discover the disturbing truth behind Lucy's dreams?

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games
